        ----------

            n_features is the number of features.

        # Encode for string labels

            class_weight = {label_encoder.transform([cls])[0]: v
                            for cls, v in class_weight.items()}

        encoded_labels = label_encoder.transform(label_encoder.classes_)

            self.n_iter_ = np.reshape(

The expected behavior is that no error should be thrown, and the model should correctly compute the mean of the coefficients without attempting to access an out-of-bounds index. The code location that should change is the line where the mean of the coefficients is calculated.
